parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no<props="intl"><ph> **Overview** page or</ph></props> ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the parser. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character or Japanese character counts as two characters.

parameters.name: ParserId
parameters.description: The parser ID. You can call the [ListParsers](~~429046~~) operation to query the list of parsers and obtain the **ParserId**.
